symbolClassification.SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND: Invalid symbol format or delisted; ticker not recognized by provider
symbolClassification.NOT_EQUITY: Instrument type is Fund, Derivative, Index, or other non-equity type
symbolClassification.NO_QUOTE: Provider returned no price quote for the symbol
symbolClassification.NO_HISTORY: Provider has price but no historical OHLCV data available
symbolClassification.RATE_LIMITED: Provider rate limit exceeded; transient error, may succeed on retry
symbolClassification.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Provider endpoint disabled or API key missing
symbolClassification.INVALID_SYMBOL: Symbol format invalid for provider (e.g., missing .IS suffix)
symbolClassification.UNKNOWN: Failure reason not classified; requires runtime investigation

MKK.notes: MKK provides market metadata where accessible, not market prices; single pipeline constraint maintained; no price data
MKK.rateLimiting: MKK API key may be required; single pipeline only

TCMB.rateLimiting: TCMB API key may be required; single pipeline only

daily.notes: Yahoo Finance real historical OHLCV for 6 test symbols via 1D timeframe. All other discovery symbols lack daily OHLCV.
daily.validation: Every candle validated: high >= max(open,close), low <= min(open,close); anomalies → INVALID

fourHour.notes: Provider does not natively support 4H BIST historical data; derived candles prohibited. Single pipeline constraint.

weekly.notes: Provider does not natively support 1W BIST historical data; weekly aggregation from daily marked as DERIVED. Single pipeline constraint.

monthly.notes: Provider does not natively support 1M BIST historical data; monthly aggregation from daily marked as DERIVED. Single pipeline constraint.

sma9.notes: SMA9 calculated from daily close prices; null when <9 data points. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

sma20.notes: SMA20 calculated from daily close prices; null when <20 data points. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

sma50.notes: SMA50 calculated from daily close prices; null when <50 data points. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

rsi.notes: RSI14 calculated from daily close prices; deterministic, documented, tested. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

macd.notes: MACD computed from daily close prices; convention documented. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

stochasticRsi.notes: Stochastic RSI from RSI foundation verified reliable; deterministic, documented, no shortcut, no hardcoded values. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

volume20Average.notes: 20-day average volume from historical data; null when insufficient sample. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

volume50Average.notes: 50-day average volume from historical data; null when insufficient sample. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

relativeVolume.notes: Current volume / 20-day average volume; null when averageVolume = 0. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

return1D.notes: 1-day return from close prices; timestamp-aware, no look-ahead bias. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

return5D.notes: 5-day return from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

return20D.notes: 20-day return from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

return60D.notes: 60-day return from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

return120D.notes: 120-day return from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

return252D.notes: 252-day (~1 year) return from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

momentum5D.notes: 5-day momentum from close prices; deterministic, no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

momentum20D.notes: 20-day momentum from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

momentum60D.notes: 60-day momentum from close prices; no future data usage. Foundation from R2-063 preserved.

distanceTo20DHigh.notes: Distance to 20-day high from historical candles; current candle excluded; no look-ahead bias. Foundation from R2-065.

distanceTo50DHigh.notes: Distance to 50-day high from historical candles; current candle excluded; no look-ahead bias. Foundation from R2-065.

isBreakout.notes: Breakout detection: current close > previous 20-day high (historical only, excluding current candle); mandatory to avoid look-ahead leakage. Foundation from R2-065.

relativeStrength.notes: Relative strength with explicit benchmark type tracking; SYNTHETIC_PROXY distinguished from OFFICIAL BIST100. Foundation from R2-062 preserved.

marketRegime.notes: Market regime with deterministic rules based on price vs SMA20 and SMA9 vs SMA20; benchmarkType explicit. Foundation from R2-062 preserved.
